# HP Color LaserJet Pro M254dw

Print documents and inspect printer or job status on the HP Color LaserJet Pro M254dw through Muse Home Link, using its advertised IPP/IPPS service and only the document formats it actually advertises. Printer and job state are read with Get-Printer-Attributes and Get-Job-Attributes through a client that encodes binary IPP (an IPP library or CUPS tooling); the document goes only to your own local printer, with any print credentials the printer requires.
